baseline_models.focus_anchor: تَعْجَلْ at word 2 is opposed to نَعُدُّ...عَدًّا at words 5 and 7.
baseline_models.mechanism: The prohibition blocks advancing an outcome before its time, while إِنَّمَا redirects agency from the addressee's haste to a presently operating exact enumeration.

activation_trace.role: Its speeding and advancing-before-time image supplies the human tempo being blocked.
Its exact-enumeration image supplies the measured process that replaces haste.

changed_reading.before: Do not hurry what will happen to them.
changed_reading.after: Do not advance their outcome yourself: an exact process is already running for them, so delay is active rather than empty.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The prohibition of premature speed and the cognate نَعُدُّ...عَدًّا construction jointly foreground timing.
baseline_models.mechanism: The counted-duration and scheduled-time branches let the count sound like a finite allotted interval being run to completion, not only objects being tallied.

activation_trace.role: Its before-the-appointed-time image creates the need for a term that must not be preempted.
Its counted-duration image turns enumeration into an allotted waiting period.
Its fixed-time image gives that period a scheduled endpoint.

changed_reading.before: We are tallying their deeds or persons.
changed_reading.after: We are counting out their allotted interval to completion; the ban on haste preserves that measured term.

context_deltas.mechanism: Writing fixes each utterance into an enforceable record while extension lengthens the punitive term; the focus count consequently becomes an accruing account with a temporal runway.

activation_trace.role: Enumeration supplies the account into which the earlier recorded material can accrue.
Its fixing that entails judgment turns what is said into an enforceable entry feeding the count.
Its lengthened-term image supplies the span across which the account continues to accrue.

structural_cues: 19:79 and 19:84 pair first-person-plural imperfect verbs with cognate accusatives: نَمُدُّ...مَدًّا and نَعُدُّ...عَدًّا.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies fixed writing, an extended term, and the matched construction; I infer that entries accrue through that extension into the focus count. A live alternative is rhetorical parallel with counting independent of writing.

changed_reading.before: The count is a bare tally or countdown.
changed_reading.after: The count is a continuously accruing, judgment-bearing record, making immediate intervention unnecessary.

context_deltas.mechanism: The preceding intensive agitation establishes a pressured rhythm; the focus prohibition refuses that rhythm and replaces it with measured enumeration.

activation_trace.role: Its premature-speed image identifies the reactive tempo the addressee must not adopt.
Its discrete enumeration supplies a controlled counter-rhythm.
Its boiling, sounding agitation image supplies the accelerated pressure immediately before the focus.

structural_cues: The adjacent intensive pair تُؤُزُّهُمْ أَزًّا is answered by فَلَا تَعْجَلْ عَلَيْهِمْ and the measured pair نَعُدُّ...عَدًّا.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies adjacent agitation, prohibited haste, and count; I infer a warning against mirroring the tempo acting on them. The alternative is that the adjacency only intensifies their condition and says nothing about mimetic response.

changed_reading.before: Do not seek their outcome too soon.
changed_reading.after: Do not let their induced agitation set your pace; the divine count contains that acceleration within a different rhythm.

context_deltas.mechanism: The focus count can function as a pre-dispatch muster: an enumerated population is assembled and then moved through sharply different procedures toward distinct destinations.

activation_trace.role: Its preparation image lets counting function as operational readiness for the movements that follow.
Its gathering and conducting a group to a destination turns readiness into assembly.
Its arrival before a sovereign marks the first assembled group's mode of reception.
Its driving and expulsion image supplies the contrasting transport imposed on the second group.
Its arrival-at-a-destination image completes the second dispatch lane.

structural_cues: The balanced adjacent clauses contrast نَحْشُرُ...وَفْدًا with نَسُوقُ...وِرْدًا immediately after the focus count.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies preparation, assembly, driving, and two arrival modes; I infer that enumeration serves as the manifest for ordered dispatch. The live alternative is simple chronological sequence without a logistical function for the count.

changed_reading.after: God is mustering them by count for a controlled sorting and dispatch, so the apparent wait is operational preparation.

context_deltas.mechanism: The later reprise joins exhaustive encompassment to the same count and then resolves the collective كُلُّهُمْ into فَرْدًا; the earlier لَهُمْ therefore denotes separately indexed persons rather than an undifferentiated mass.

activation_trace.role: The focus enumeration establishes the count whose unit is clarified later.
Its exhaustive-enumeration image removes the possibility of an approximate or merely collective count.
The exact lexical reprise carries the focus count into the later statement of total coverage.
Its solitary-unit image identifies each person as an irreducible item within the total.

structural_cues: 19:94 repeats عَدَّهُمْ عَدًّا, and 19:95 immediately pairs كُلُّهُمْ with فَرْدًا.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies exact lexical reprise, exhaustive coverage, and solitary arrival; I infer that persons are individually indexed in the earlier count. A live alternative is that 19:84 primarily counts days, deeds, or utterances while 19:94 counts persons.

changed_reading.before: We count them as a collective object of judgment.
changed_reading.after: Every member of the collective is already exhaustively and individually indexed; none is hidden inside the plural.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: The count-to-zero model is surprising because no branch states numerical subtraction; it remains anchored in the focus enumeration and the later sequence of destruction, failed sensing, exhaustive negation, and inaudible trace. Render it only as a cross-domain metaphor for no detectable remainder, not as the ayah's asserted arithmetic.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: نَعُدُّ لَهُمْ عَدًّا can be carried forward as a process whose counted population eventually leaves no sensibly recoverable remainder.

activation_trace.role: Exact enumeration supplies the numerical frame from which the zero-remainder metaphor is inferred.
Its falling into destruction supplies the removal process.
Its sensory-detection image supplies the first test for any remainder.
Its exhaustive-negation image reduces the detectable persons to none.
Its faint-sound image supplies the final minimal trace that is no longer heard.

changed_reading.before: The count delays a future judgment.
changed_reading.after: Exploratorily, the measured process runs a generation down to no detectable human or acoustic remainder.

strongest_changes: 19:83 turns the prohibition into a refusal to mirror the adversaries' agitated tempo.
19:94-95 resolves the count as exhaustive person-by-person indexing.
19:79 and 19:85-86 make the count active as both an accruing record and a pre-dispatch muster.
summary.what_was_special: The focus's haste/count opposition became a control-of-tempo mechanism: pressure accelerates, while inscription, enumeration, preparation, and individual dispatch proceed at a measured pace.
remaining_uncertainties: The counted unit may be persons, utterances, deeds, days, or several of these at once.
The preparation branch of ع د د may supply a genuine lexical activation or only a functional inference from the following muster.
The counter-rhythm reading depends on treating the adjacency and paired cognate constructions as mechanistically significant.
